timestamp_selection.at_or_before: greatest presentation timestamp <= target; null only when target is before the first frame
timestamp_selection.at_or_after: smallest presentation timestamp >= target; null only when target is after the final frame
timestamp_selection.nearest: minimum absolute presentation-time distance; ties choose the earlier frame
timestamp_selection.exact_frame_index: sequential presentation-frame index, zero based; out-of-range is not clamped
